title: Machan Alchemist Trailer Deck
project: Machan intro: a movie-style trailer for Machan's The Alchemist (young Machan travels the world, one lesson per encounter); after swatch-v2 was 'closer but still way off'
example_data: All app screens are rendered HTML mockups with made-up SAMPLE data (sample project notes, .example domains).

pairs.ask: What should the trailer look like?

optionA.label: Painterly watercolour storybook
optionA.desc: Soft washes on cream paper, like the v2 backgrounds.

optionB.label: Rich cinematic illustration
optionB.desc: Deep light and depth, like an animated-feature still.

pairs.ask: How does Machan sit in the world?

optionA.label: Painted into the world
optionA.desc: Machan in the same brushwork as the scene, with a real shadow.

optionB.label: Clean vector mascot
optionB.desc: The crisp Machan mark placed on the painted scene, like v2.
optionB.more: Always on brand, but sits on top.

pairs.ask: Does Machan dress for the road?

optionA.label: Backpack and cloak
optionA.desc: A tiny canvas backpack, a short cream cloak and a walking stick.

optionB.label: Plain Machan
optionB.desc: Just Machan, as on the footer and the story page.

optionA.label: Deep old storyteller
optionA.desc: A slow, warm older voice, like a tale by the fire.

optionB.label: Machan, first person
optionB.desc: Machan looks back on his road, an Alchemist-style reflection.

optionA.label: Quote card
optionA.desc: Cream card, one line in our own words, the 真工素 seal.

optionB.label: Cold open on a landscape
optionB.desc: No words. Mist over the terraces, then the music comes in.
optionB.more: Pulls you straight into the world.

optionA.label: A few long, slow shots
optionA.desc: Five or six shots, each held 8 to 10 seconds.

optionB.label: Montage of quick glimpses
optionB.desc: Many 1 to 2 second cuts across the whole journey.

optionA.label: Solo instrument
optionA.desc: One koto or bamboo flute, sparse, with room to breathe.

optionB.label: Swelling orchestral build
optionB.desc: Strings and low drums rise to a big moment at the title.

optionA.label: Drawn map with a path line
optionA.desc: A painted map; a terracotta dotted line walks from stop to stop.
optionA.more: Ties the stops into one journey.

optionB.label: No map
optionB.desc: Cut straight from place to place.

optionA.label: Lessons on screen
optionA.desc: Each stop ends on its lesson: "Read the seed. Build for the season."

optionB.label: Only title cards
optionB.desc: Just the place name between stops; the narrator carries the lessons.

optionA.label: Home all along
optionA.desc: Machan returns to his own tree and finds the treasure was there.

optionB.label: The journey continues
optionB.desc: A boat heads out to sea. "To be continued."
optionB.more: A cliffhanger that invites the next chapter.

pairs.ask: Add a desert nod to The Alchemist?

optionA.label: Desert and omens
optionA.desc: One desert stop with hawks and a falling feather as omens.
optionA.more: A clear nod to the book.

optionB.label: Only Machan's places
optionB.desc: Japan, the Ozarks, Thailand and the sea, nothing borrowed.
